annotations.title: Check a FiLot gold bar record

description: Checks a FiLot gold bar record against the public Solana blockchain, from the owner's share link (https://filot.me/verify#p=...) or a delivery's check link (https://filot.me/delivery#c=...). A serial number alone is never checked. It verifies the record, not the metal.

link.description: The FiLot share link or delivery link exactly as given by the owner or printed on the delivery papers.

name: verify_gold_bar_record
title: Check a FiLot gold bar record
